minimum.graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB (DirectX 12 feature level 11.0)
minimum.notes: SSD strongly recommended. HDD supported with extended loading times. Integrated graphics not supported.

recommended.graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800 XT (8GB VRAM minimum)
recommended.notes: Ray tracing (Lumen) requires DirectX 12 Ultimate. Nanite Landscape requires feature level 12.0.

ultra.graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4080 / AMD RX 7900 XTX (16GB VRAM)
ultra.notes: Ultra tier: 64-ray geometric audio, full runtime Voronoi, Nanite Landscape at max density.
